observations.verification: Same four views plus connected component inspection; no floating foot component.

observations.element: geometry_0 / cushion silhouette and back panel
observations.defect: Strong faceting and irregular sawtooth silhouettes; coherent smooth cushion contours from the reference are not retained.
observations.expected_improvement: Smoother geometric contours at unchanged viewing and lighting settings.
observations.verification: Compare silhouette curvature and facet count at same camera settings; smoothing normals alone does not establish geometric improvement.

color_limit: Neural vertex colours are preserved and linked explicitly in Blender; display shader roughness/light exposure are not inferred PBR. Render colours and reference lighting are not calibrated for pixelwise fidelity scoring.
topology_caveat: Raw PLY inspection finds 68 boundary edges. Existing PR12 inspector merges positions within 1e-6 in temporary bmesh before checking and finds 0 nonmanifold edges. These diagnostics differ; do not claim 68 visible holes. Visible disconnected parts remain genuine defects.

corrections_in_this_stage.detail: Disabled OpenImageDenoise unavailable in actual Blender build; no samples/resolution reduction.
GLB contains vertex colors but no material. Added neutral shader connected to imported color attribute; archived initial white-material renders.

next_experiment: Keep same checkpoint, input, threshold25 and render views; extract retained neural scene codes at128, measure time/RAM and semantic fragmentation before deciding whether denser extraction helps.
